name: Поля й загроза зв’язки (1)
description:
In this lesson we focus on the pin. By attacking both a piece and a square on which a pin can be executed, material can be gained. See the example.

What do you have to do?

Win material by attacking both a piece and a square on which a token can be executed.

examples.text: 1.Rc2! attacks both the bishop and square e2. After 1...Bf7 2.Re2 white wins the bishop by pinning this piece.
